findings.text: follow-on: SUMMARY_RE matches the '=== FAILURES ===' banner and the 'short test summary info' header as well as pytest's final summary line, and run_arm appends EXIT= unconditionally, so a truncated arm log (a run that died mid-suite) would pass the population-job.sbatch:94-95 guards and its partial FAILED set be read by added_failures_from_gate_logs as a complete measured set; both arms here carried the real final summary, so this does not hold the node.

follow-on: the base-absent set is the single hardcoded name $NEWFILE rather than derived from the base tree, so the brief's 'the same list minus any file absent from the base tree' holds only while exactly one candidate-added file exists; a second such file would be passed to pytest at base and abort the job at population-job.sbatch:94 instead of being subtracted (verified: at f339f0eda exactly one list entry is absent).
